result.reason: The operative redline reaches the fallback by making the existing section-specific 12-month cap mutual and adding all four required fallback carve-outs. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks the USD 1,000,000 floor and greater-of formula, payable fees and a claim-based lookback, mutual indirect/consequential damages exclusions, and the data protection, security, fraud, IP infringement, and payment-obligation protections. The edits are confined to cap mutuality and carve-outs, but drafting quality is materially impaired by the malformed phrase “SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT,” the undefined reference point for “immediately preceding,” and imperfect parallelism in the carve-out list.
